audit.whatIsWrong: Zac wins 49.52% over 208 games — this is the one losing matchup in my slice — but the content chart gives Zac 5 of 7 stages and the full layer gives him 4 of 7.
audit.why: Both layers present a losing lane as a winning one. The entry's own late text already says "her scaling offsets your strong early windows", so the prose and the chart disagree with each other as well as with the data.
audit.corrected: First item becomes Skill and 2+ items becomes Vayne in both layers, giving Vayne 3, Zac 3, Skill 1 — Zac owning levels 2-5 and Vayne owning 1, 6 and the scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Silver Bolts is described as "third-hit true damage" that "melts even your tank HP", with no mention that it procs on abilities or that it scales off Zac's own health.
audit.why: Two things are missing. It triggers on "the third consecutive attack or ability against the same target", so her Q and E advance the counter — a Zac who counts only autos will mistime the third hit. And it takes a percentage of the target's maximum health, meaning every point of HP Zac buys makes it hit harder. That turns Heartsteel from an unambiguous spike into a trade-off, which no field currently says.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[2].text, whys[5] and full phases[5].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tumble's auto-attack reset is never mentioned, though the entry tells the player to "bait Condemn" four separate times.
audit.why: Vayne's burst opens with a Tumble reset — the wind-up, not the ability cast, is the moment to react. _missing-interactions.json flags exactly this for the matchup and nothing in either layer carries it.
audit.corrected: Added to spikes[0].text and breakdown.cooldowns as the burst tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns says only "Wall-stun. Don't get pinned. Track it before every engage" and the content layer says "bait Condemn" without ever giving its cooldown.
audit.why: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12 — 20 seconds at rank 1, by far the longest cooldown in her kit and the entire reason baiting it works. "Bait it" without the number gives the player nothing to count.
audit.corrected: Added the rank-1 figure to spikes[0].text and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] covers Final Hour's stealth but not that it also shortens Tumble.
audit.why: Final Hour grants invisibility during Tumble AND reduced Tumble cooldown on a base of 6/5/4/3/2. Her escape frequency, not just her escape quality, changes at 6 — which is what makes chasing her after the ult a losing proposition.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Vayne as male in four places: tradeBad and dontsFull[2].d ("Letting him stomp your blobs"), breakdown.trading (same phrase), and dontsFull[0].d ("half his win condition is gone").
audit.why: Template artifact from the generator. Every one is a same-length word swap, so they cost nothing to fix.
audit.corrected: him -> her, his -> her in all four.
